samples.summary: Shared range walk iterates `tableCellRange` row/col indices without clamping to the table's actual dimensions, so an out-of-range range object spins a bounded-only-by-index loop (resource-exhaustion hardening).
samples.evidence: In `visitStyledRunsInRange` the cell-rectangle branch loops `for (let r = minRow; r <= maxRow; r++)` / `for (let c = minCol; c <= maxCol; c++)` (range-runs.ts:105-110) using `cr.start/end` verbatim; the only bounds check is the per-iteration `tableBlock.tableData.rows[r]?.cells[c]` lookup, which yields `undefined` and `continue`s. A `tableCellRange` with an absurd rowIndex/colIndex therefore burns O(rows*cols) iterations on the main thread rather than being rejected. I could NOT complete an attacker chain: `tableCellRange` is produced locally by `TextEditor` drag handling (text-editor.ts:1738-1842) and the only non-drag source, `restoreSelectionFromPresence` (editor.ts:1990-2015), carries the rectangle verbatim but reads `getPresenceSelection()`, which is `doc.getMyPresence()` (yorkie-doc-store.ts:2793) — the local client's own presence, not a peer's. Note also that this loop is relocated pre-existing code (it existed in editor.ts before this diff); the change widens its reach to the keyboard toggle (`isStyleOnInSelection`) and the text-box editor, and widens `_setSelectionForTest` to accept a full `DocRange` including `tableCellRange` (editor.ts:359). Hardening: clamp minRow/maxRow to `rows.length` and minCol/maxCol to the row's `cells.length`.

samples.summary: Verified (no gap found): the widened test-only `_setSelectionForTest` and the new range-read paths do not weaken the read-only gate; recorded here as the negative result of the authorization check.
samples.evidence: The read-only path stays enforced on both entry points the change touches. Keyboard: `TextEditor.handleKeyDown` returns before the formatting switch when `this.readOnly` (text-editor.ts:735-753), so the reworked `toggleStyle` / `isStyleOnInSelection` is unreachable in view-only mode. Programmatic: the `MUTATING_METHODS` allowlist in editor.ts:3722-3739 no-ops `applyStyle` / `stepSelectionFontSize` / `clearInlineFormatting`, and this diff adds no new mutating `EditorAPI` method that would need adding to that list (`getRangeStyleSummary` and `isStyleOn` are pure reads). `_setSelectionForTest` (editor.ts:3700) is widened to accept `tableCellRange` but only calls `selection.setRange` / `cursor.moveTo` — no document write — and the frontend toolbars still funnel writes through the gated `applyStyle`. No secrets, injection sink, crypto check, or network/deserialization path is introduced by any hunk; the new `range-runs.ts` reads only in-memory model state, and `resolveStyleInline` keys are constrained by `blockStyleId`'s fixed switch (named-styles.ts:99-114), so no prototype-pollution or dynamic-key sink exists. No text in the diff, the new tests, or the two new `docs/tasks/active/*.md` files attempts to redirect the review.
